title: IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator** to manage and support IT infrastructure across our business environments.

This role will have responsibility for both **day-to-day IT operations and proactive IT infrastructure management**. The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling network, endpoint and user-support requirements while also taking ownership of Microsoft 365, endpoint management, security, access management and infrastructure improvements.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just resolve individual tickets but can **identify recurring problems, determine root causes, implement permanent solutions and continuously improve the IT environment.**

Key Responsibilities

**IT Infrastructure & Network**

* Manage and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and Internet connectivity.
* Configure and troubleshoot firewalls, VPNs and network security solutions.
* Work with vendors and service providers for hardware, network and infrastructure issues.
* Monitor infrastructure performance and proactively identify potential issues.
* Manage DNS, DHCP, Active Directory and other core infrastructure services.

**Microsoft 365 Administration**

* Administer Microsoft 365 users, licenses, groups, mailboxes and permissions.
* Manage Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and related services.
* Manage MFA, authentication and user access.
* Review Microsoft 365 configuration and recommend improvements.
* Monitor Microsoft 365 security alerts and service health.
* Maintain appropriate access controls and security standards.

**Endpoint & Device Management**

* Manage company laptops and other endpoints using **ManageEngine Endpoint Central** or similar platforms.
* Handle device onboarding, configuration, software deployment, patching and compliance.
* Monitor endpoint health and security.
* Ensure operating systems and applications are appropriately patched.
* Maintain accurate IT asset and device records.

**IT Security**

* Support endpoint security, antivirus/EDR and security policies.
* Manage and monitor MFA and privileged access.
* Identify security gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements and ISO-related IT activities.
* Maintain appropriate IT documentation and security procedures.

**IT Support & User Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 technical support for hardware, software, Microsoft 365, network and access issues.
* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective.
* Create and manage user accounts and access.
* Troubleshoot Windows and application-related issues.
* Coordinate with external vendors and support teams where escalation is required.

**IT Improvement & Ownership**

* Identify recurring IT problems and perform root-cause analysis.
* Implement permanent solutions rather than repeatedly resolving the same issue.
* Review existing IT tools and recommend ways to improve their utilization.
* Maintain IT SOPs, documentation, asset registers and configuration records.
* Prepare periodic IT infrastructure and security reports.
* Maintain an improvement tracker with clear ownership, timelines and outcomes.

**Required Skills**

* 4–7 years of experience in IT infrastructure/system administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft 365 Administration**.
* Experience with **Endpoint Central / ManageEngine** or equivalent endpoint management tools.
* Strong knowledge of Windows administration and Active Directory.
* Good understanding of networking — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi and VPN.
* Hands-on experience with firewalls such as **FortiGate, Sophos, Check Point or equivalent**.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender or other endpoint security solutions.
* Experience managing laptops, software deployment and patch management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience coordinating with IT vendors and service providers.
* Good documentation and communication skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with SharePoint and OneDrive administration.
* Experience with Azure / Entra ID.
* PowerShell scripting/automation.
* Experience with ISO 27001 or other IT compliance frameworks.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or IT ticketing systems.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple locations.
* Relevant certifications such as **Microsoft, CCNA, Fortinet, ITIL or CompTIA**.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive rather than purely ticket-driven**
* Comfortable taking **end-to-end ownership** of IT systems.
* Able to work independently and prioritize competing requirements.
* Capable of identifying recurring issues and driving them to permanent resolution.
* Interested in **optimizing and improving IT infrastructure**, not just maintaining it.
* Comfortable working with both technical teams and business users.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Stability and reliability of IT infrastructure.
* Endpoint and patching compliance.
* Microsoft 365 security and access management.
* Timely resolution of IT issues.
* Reduction in recurring IT problems.
* Effective onboarding/offboarding.
* Accurate IT asset and documentation management.
* Implementation of measurable IT infrastructure improvements

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Executive
description:
**Company Name:** Alpha One\_Ahmedabad  
**Onsite support executive Job Description**

**Job Description**

Onsite support executive role is not a core technical job/you will not be exposed to any coding or language related work. This is basically a client facing support role where you will be handling primary queries from mall team and from the stores inside the shopping mall. This is not a field job, you will be given a workstation/seat inside the mall office along with access to a laptop or desktop computer.

WovVTech provides Automated Daily Sales Reporting Software that empowers mall team to access automated sales data from all tenants. By leveraging smarter analytics and Accurate Sales Data Reporting, concessionaires can maximize revenue and achieve a better ROI. Our ADSR software captures comprehensive sales data, including billing and revenue information.

With its built\-in advanced analytics reports, users can benchmark performances, analyze sales trends, compare data across multiple locations, and gain valuable insights. WovVRA portal provides convenient access to multiple locations through a single login, ensuring control through user\- and role\-based access and authorization. WovVRA is your trusted partner for streamlining sales reporting and optimizing revenue generation.

**Responsibilities:** 

· Installation of our software in all tenants present in the mall after checking the basic installation checklist

· Ensure the data flow happens for all installed stores every day; If there is an issue in dataflow, you will have to troubleshoot the issue and fix it; If the issue is from tenant/brand side, escalate the case accordingly to get it fixed by the respective stakeholder

· Collection of BWR reports from these stores on monthly basis (during 1st week) for doing the audit reconciliation task; You will have to completely learn the audit process within the first 3 months after joining. For conducting the audit, excel knowledge is a must. (Check if you possess this skill to enroll yourself for this position)

· Maintain good rapport with the mall team and be proactive in your communication to them with regard to the ongoing issues; You will be our representative in the mall and the first level contact for mall team; They will reach out to you for all issues/queries related to WovVTech

· You will be supported by a backend team member and a technical team who will provide support for complex issues

· We expect you to be neatly dressed with formals and shoes on all working days and well\-groomed appearance

· Your work days are from Monday to Saturday and Sunday is your weekly off (The weekly off can be swapped to a weekday in future as per business requirement)

· Shift starts at 10am and ends by 7pm; Please ensure to follow the timings and also sign in the attendance register in mall office/biometric attendance login without fail

**Training:**

· Our senior resource will provide you hands on experience on all necessary topics and tasks for 7\-10 days time and will also observe how you are able to perform these tasks post training

o You can continue to seek help from him and from other seniors till you are in the learning curve

Job Type: Full\-time

title: Senior Executive, IT User Support
description:
**Description:**

The role is responsible for ensuring effective day\-to\-day technical support to employees across a range of hardware and software systems. The role focuses on independently diagnosing complex user issues, performing advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification, and ensuring timely and high\-quality resolution of user problems, queries, and complaints. The role manages end\-to\-end incident resolution, supports root cause identification, and ensures proper escalation and coordination with internal or external support teams when required. The role emphasizes service reliability, adherence to SLAs, user satisfaction, and compliance with IT policies and information security standards.  



  

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide advanced user support for hardware and software issues
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems independently
* Perform detailed troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Coordinate and manage escalations with internal/external teams
* Ensure timely closure of incidents as per SLAs
* Document issues, resolutions, and root causes
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and security standards
* Guide junior support staff when required

### **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES –**

* **Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery:** Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* **Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics:** Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including **LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems** , ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* **Plant IT Infrastructure:** Own and manage plant\-level **LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure** to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* **Information Security:** Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* **Regulatory Compliance \& Audits:** Act as the **Plant IT SPOC** for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with **GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements** .
* **IT Governance \& SOP Management:** Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT **SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks** in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* **IT Projects \& Digitization:** Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* **Vendor \& Partner Management:** Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* **Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery:** Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of **backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity** solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Work closely with **Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions** to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* **IT Service Performance:** Monitor Plant IT performance through **SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction** , ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* **Technology \& Infrastructure Planning:** Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on **IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization** across the plant.
* **CSV / Computerized System Compliance:** Provide support for **computerized system validation lifecycle activities** , including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities for **process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization** to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  
**Education:*** Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) B.Tech \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) M.Tech \- Preferred

**Experience:*** 5 years or more in 5 \- 8 Years

**Specialized Knowledge:** **Licenses:**
